body.message:
Hello,

Thank you for sharing the updated rates. I wanted to check if there is any flexibility on the pricing, as the current rates are quite above my guest’s budget.

The guest is genuinely interested in proceeding with the booking and is also willing to make the full payment in one shot. Considering this, would it be possible to offer us a better rate or a special long-term price for the 8-month stay?

We would really appreciate your best possible offer.
